verdict.rationale: Copilot's own docs say users can "Choose from leading LLMs optimized for speed, accuracy, or cost" and that it "supports multiple AI models, each with different strengths", with an auto-select option as well. The multi-provider part is supported only indirectly, through agents from Anthropic and OpenAI (Claude, Codex) being assignable. missing for 10: an explicit list of model providers in the model picker, documentation of how a model is selected per session, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers
